## Module to write
path: ServerScriptService/UpgradeService.luau
purpose: Feature: Dropper tiers and an upgrade tree, data-driven: a new ReplicatedStorage/Upgrades config lists about 12 upgrades with id, name, cost, requires (parent id) and effect. Tree: 4 dropper slots (Dropper 2/3/4 each requiring the previous), 3 dropper tiers that change the ore every dropper spits out (Bronze ore 1 cash -> Silver 3 -> Gold 8 -> Diamond 20; each tier has its own color and material, e.g. Gold is shiny Foil yellow, Diamond is glass cyan with sparkles), 2 conveyor speed upgrades, and 2 'Cash Multiplier' upgrades (x1.5, x2) on the collector. Costs grow so a full tree takes about 8-10 minutes (first buy costs 10 and is affordable within 10 seconds). An UpgradeService on the server owns which upgrades each player has bought, validates requires + cost atomically, applies the effect to that player's Tycoon, and fires an UpgradeBought remote to the client. Buy pads on the owner's plot show a BillboardGui price tag with the upgrade name and cost, are only visible once their parent is bought, turn the plot's accent color when affordable, and vanish after purchase. Bump counters upgrades_bought and tier_upgrades. -- Server ModuleScript with API init(), onPlotClaimed(player, plot) and onPlayerRemoving(player). It owns per-player state {owned = {[id]=true}, pads = {...}}. init() creates the RemoteEvent 'UpgradeBought' in ReplicatedStorage; this is the only place it is created. onPlotClaimed builds one buy pad per upgrade on the owner's plot, using the exact plot fields PlotBuilder returns (read them from that file; no guessed fallbacks). Pads sit in a row off the spawn and walking path, colored from the plot theme (PlotThemes). Each pad has a BillboardGui reading '<name> - $<cost>'. A pad is visible and touchable only when its parent is owned (or it has none) and it is not yet bought. Hidden means Transparency 1, CanTouch false and the billboard disabled. A pad turns the plot's accent color when the owner's Cash >= cost and a neutral theme color otherwise. This is refreshed on the Cash leaderstat Changed connection and after each purchase. The Touched handler resolves the player, accepts only the plot owner, applies a per-player debounce, then checks not owned, requires owned and Cash >= cost. It deducts the cost, marks the upgrade owned and hides the pad in the same synchronous step, with no yield between check and deduct. After that it recomputes the modifiers (slots = 1 + dropper upgrades, ore = highest tier owned (default 1), speedMult = product of owned speed mults, cashMult = highest owned cashMult (default 1)) and calls Tycoon.setModifiers(player, mods). It then calls UpgradeBought:FireClient(player, id, mods). It bumps ForgeTelemetry.count('upgrades_bought', 1) on every purchase and ForgeTelemetry.count('tier_upgrades', 1) when effect.kind == 'tier'; these counters are bumped only here. onPlayerRemoving destroys the pads, disconnects connections and clears the state. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: upgrades_bought, tier_upgrades.

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Count each telemetry counter in exactly one place (the module that owns the event). Duplicate count calls push once-only counters past their expected value.
- Touched fires many times per touch: debounce per player (a per-player cooldown or a one-time purchased flag) and check and deduct cost in the same step to prevent double-buys or double-spends.
- Define the data shape that a builder module returns (field names such as origin, gate, spawn) once, and have consumers use those exact fields. Do not add `a or b` fallbacks for guessed names.

## Fixing and debugging
- A "sync" StudioError about not being able to serve a path is an infrastructure or environment failure, not a code bug. Do not change game code in response. Retry the step.
- If the critic says a code path was never exercised in the playtest, fix the pacing or setup so the path actually runs (e.g. cheaper first purchase) instead of only adding more code.
- When the spec changes the flow (e.g. from auto-assign to claim), rewrite the entry script (Game.server) to require and wire the new modules, and delete the old flow's logic (slots, teleport on join). Updating only the new modules leaves the old behaviour running.
- After a redesign, check that every module is required by the entry script and that its init function is called. Unwired modules never run, and their counters never fire.

## UI kit (house style for all UI: paste the snippets you use, Theme first, and adapt; plain Luau, not modules)
- Chunky text: every label gets a dark UIStroke (2.5-4 px). LuckiestGuy for titles/numbers, FredokaOne for body. Never default or thin fonts.
- One palette everywhere: yellow Primary = main action, green Good = affordable/claim, red Bad = close/can't, blue Info = secondary, dark Ink outlines.
- Depth: UICorner 12-18 px, UIStroke border, light-top UIGradient fill, hard drop shadow 4-6 px below.
- Everything moves: appear with a Back-eased UIScale pop (0 -> 1), react with a punch (1.2 -> 1), press squish to 0.9. Tween UIScale, not Size; 0.1-0.4 s, never linear.
- Numbers tick up and pop on change, big values short ("12.5K"); gains flash green, losses red.
- Every action gives feedback: toast, floating "+N" or reward popup. Max 3 toasts.
- Mobile first: 1280x720 offsets under a viewport UIScale (`Theme.screen`), safe insets, buttons >= 44 px, nothing key in the top-left (Roblox menu).
- HUD hugs the edges, centre stays clear; windows open over a dim backdrop with a close X.
- World prices on BillboardGuis: green when affordable, red when not.
- UI is built in code with Instance.new, no image asset ids (emoji/letters for icons), ResetOnSpawn = false.

```luau
-- PriceBillboard: world price tag over a buy pad / shop item; green when affordable, red when not. Server or client.
-- Standalone (no Theme needed) so a server Script can paste it too.
local function priceBillboard(part: BasePart, title: string, price: number): (BillboardGui, (boolean) -> ())
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size, bb.StudsOffset = UDim2.fromScale(6, 2.2), Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 2, 0)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop, bb.MaxDistance, bb.LightInfluence = false, 80, 0
	bb.Adornee = part
	local function text(t: string, y: number, h: number, color: Color3): TextLabel
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.Size, l.Position, l.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.fromScale(1, h), UDim2.fromScale(0, y), 1
		l.Text, l.Font, l.TextScaled, l.TextColor3 = t, Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy, true, color
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		s.Thickness, s.Color = 3, Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
		s.Parent = l
		l.Parent = bb
		return l
	end
	text(title, 0, 0.45, Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232))
	local cost = text("$" .. tostring(price), 0.45, 0.55, Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64))
	bb.Parent = part
	local function setAffordable(ok: boolean)
		cost.TextColor3 = if ok then Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92) else Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
	end
	return bb, setAffordable -- client: call setAffordable(cash.Value >= price) on cash.Changed
end
```

```luau
--!nonstrict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Upgrades = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Upgrades"))
local Telemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))
local PlotThemes = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlotThemes"))
local Tycoon = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Tycoon"))

local UpgradeService = {}

local NEUTRAL = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135)
local DEBOUNCE = 0.35
local COLS = 6
local SPACING = 5.5

local list: { any } = Upgrades.list or Upgrades
local byId: { [string]: any } = {}
for _, u in ipairs(list) do
	byId[u.id] = u
end

local states: { [Player]: any } = {}
local boughtRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil

local function pickColor(t: any, keys: { string }, default: Color3): Color3
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return default
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
		if typeof(t[k]) == "Color3" then
			return t[k]
		end
	end
	return default
end

local function num(t: any, keys: { string }, default: number): number
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return default
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
		if type(t[k]) == "number" then
			return t[k]
		end
	end
	return default
end

local function kindOf(u: any): string
	local e = u.effect
	if type(e) == "table" and type(e.kind) == "string" then
		return string.lower(e.kind)
	end
	return ""
end

local function computeMods(owned: { [string]: boolean })
	local slots, ore, speed, cash = 1, 1, 1, 1
	for id in pairs(owned) do
		local u = byId[id]
		if u then
			local k = kindOf(u)
			local e = u.effect
			if k == "slot" or k == "dropper" then
				slots += 1
			elseif k == "tier" then
				ore = math.max(ore, num(e, { "tier", "ore", "value" }, 1))
			elseif k == "speed" or k == "conveyor" then
				speed *= num(e, { "mult", "value", "speed" }, 1)
			elseif k == "cashmult" or k == "cash" or k == "multiplier" then
				cash = math.max(cash, num(e, { "mult", "value", "cashMult" }, 1))
			end
		end
	end
	return { slots = slots, ore = ore, speedMult = speed, cashMult = cash }
end

local function getCash(player: Player): IntValue?
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local c = ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if c and (c:IsA("IntValue") or c:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return c :: any
	end
	return nil
end

local function padVisible(state: any, u: any): boolean
	if state.owned[u.id] then
		return false
	end
	return u.requires == nil or state.owned[u.requires] == true
end

local function refresh(state: any)
	local cash = getCash(state.player)
	local value = cash and cash.Value or 0
	for id, pad in pairs(state.pads) do
		local u = byId[id]
		if pad.part.Parent and u then
			local visible = padVisible(state, u)
			pad.part.Transparency = visible and 0 or 1
			pad.part.CanTouch = visible
			pad.gui.Enabled = visible
			if visible then
				pad.part.Color = (value >= u.cost) and state.accent or NEUTRAL
			end
		end
	end
end

local function buy(state: any, id: string)
	local u = byId[id]
	local cash = getCash(state.player)
	if not u or not cash then
		return
	end
	if state.owned[id] or (u.requires ~= nil and not state.owned[u.requires]) or cash.Value < u.cost then
		return
	end
	-- atomic: no yields between check and deduct
	cash.Value -= u.cost
	state.owned[id] = true
	local pad = state.pads[id]
	if pad then
		pad.part.Transparency = 1
		pad.part.CanTouch = false
		pad.gui.Enabled = false
	end
	local mods = computeMods(state.owned)
	if type(Tycoon.setModifiers) == "function" then
		Tycoon.setModifiers(state.player, mods)
	end
	Telemetry.count("upgrades_bought", 1)
	if kindOf(u) == "tier" then
		Telemetry.count("tier_upgrades", 1)
	end
	if boughtRemote then
		boughtRemote:FireClient(state.player, id, mods)
	end
	refresh(state)
end

local function makePad(state: any, u: any, index: number, origin: CFrame, folder: Folder)
	local col = (index - 1) % COLS
	local row = math.floor((index - 1) / COLS)
	local lx = (col - (COLS - 1) / 2) * SPACING
	local lz = 15 - row * SPACING
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "UpgradePad_" .. tostring(u.id)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(4, 0.6, 4)
	part.CFrame = origin * CFrame.new(lx, 1, lz)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	part.Color = NEUTRAL
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.CanTouch = false

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(7, 2)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = 80
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Adornee = part
	gui.Enabled = false
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232)
	label.Text = string.format("%s - $%d", tostring(u.name), u.cost)
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Thickness = 3
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
	stroke.Parent = label
	label.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = part
	part.Parent = folder

	state.pads[u.id] = { part = part, gui = gui }
	part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local p = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		if not p or p ~= state.player or states[p] ~= state then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - state.lastTouch < DEBOUNCE then
			return
		end
		state.lastTouch = now
		buy(state, u.id)
	end)
end

function UpgradeService.init()
	local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("UpgradeBought")
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		boughtRemote = existing
		return
	end
	local r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	r.Name = "UpgradeBought"
	r.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	boughtRemote = r
end

function UpgradeService.onPlotClaimed(player: Player, plot: any)
	if states[player] then
		UpgradeService.onPlayerRemoving(player)
	end
	local theme = plot.theme
	if theme == nil and plot.index ~= nil then
		theme = PlotThemes.getTheme(plot.index)
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "UpgradePads_" .. player.Name
	local state = {
		player = player,
		owned = {},
		pads = {},
		conns = {},
		folder = folder,
		lastTouch = 0,
		accent = pickColor(theme, { "accent", "Accent", "accentColor" }, Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92)),
	}
	states[player] = state
	for i, u in ipairs(list) do
		makePad(state, u, i, plot.origin, folder)
	end
	folder.Parent = workspace
	refresh(state)

	local function hookCash(cash: Instance)
		table.insert(state.conns, (cash :: any).Changed:Connect(function()
			refresh(state)
		end))
		refresh(state)
	end
	local cash = getCash(player)
	if cash then
		hookCash(cash)
	else
		task.spawn(function()
			local ls = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 10)
			local c = ls and ls:WaitForChild("Cash", 10)
			if c and states[player] == state then
				hookCash(c)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function UpgradeService.onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	states[player] = nil
	for _, c in ipairs(state.conns) do
		c:Disconnect()
	end
	if state.folder then
		state.folder:Destroy()
	end
	state.pads = {}
	state.owned = {}
end

return UpgradeService
```
